undo_confirm.title: Undo change set #{number}?
undo_confirm.description: Restores the file to how it was before this change set, then reloads the page. | Restores {count} files to how they were before this change set, then reloads the page.
undo_confirm.description_conflict: Restores the file to how it was before this change set. A later change set touches the same file. | Restores {count} files to how they were before this change set. A later change set touches the same files.

undo_confirm.include_later: Also undo the later change sets
undo_confirm.include_later_hint: Safe: undoing this one alone keeps their lines and may not compile.

hints.next_turn: Applies to new turns. Open chats lose the agent's memory; transcripts stay.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Which agent answers, and how long it thinks.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.description: Default for new chats. Each chat can change it from the composer.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Default for new chats. Each chat can change it from the composer.

skills.label: Skills
skills.description: Where the assistant's skills come from.

history.label: History
history.description: How long change sets can be undone.

provider.label: Coding agent
provider.description: Runs on this machine, in the project folder. Your code only goes to the provider you pick; a failing agent never falls back to the other.
provider.unavailable: Not set up on this machine

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.description: Anthropic · model chosen by Claude Code

codex.label: Codex
codex.description: OpenAI · runs on your ChatGPT plan, once signed in below

signed_out.title: Run Codex on your ChatGPT plan
signed_out.description: Sign in with ChatGPT to use your plan's Codex usage here, with no API key. If the DMS runs on another machine, the page OpenAI sends you back to won't load: paste its address with “Paste the return address”.

signed_in.title: Codex runs on the ChatGPT plan of {email}
signed_in.description: Its usage counts toward your plan's limits, which you can cap per app in ChatGPT's settings.

sign_out_confirm.title: Sign out of ChatGPT?
sign_out_confirm.description: Codex stops working on every DMS project of this machine until you sign in again. To remove dms-ai from your ChatGPT account entirely, disconnect it in ChatGPT's settings.

paste.title: Finish signing in with ChatGPT
paste.description: After you allowed access, OpenAI sent you to an address starting with http://127.0.0.1 that could not load. Copy that whole address from the address bar and paste it here. It works once, within 10 minutes.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.description: How long the agent reasons before acting. More thinking is slower and uses more tokens.

mode.label: Approval mode
mode.description: What the assistant may do without asking you first.

normal.label: Ask first
normal.description: Asks before any change outside the Builder.

acceptEdits.label: Accept edits
acceptEdits.description: Applies file edits, asks for the rest.

auto.label: Full auto
auto.description: Not available as a default. Turn it on per chat, for a limited time.

always_ask.label: Always ask for
always_ask.description: These ask in every mode, including Full auto.

always_ask_deletions.label: Deleting pages, tables, fields or queries
always_ask_deletions.locked: Deleting pages, tables, fields or queries · locked

always_ask_dependencies.label: Adding or removing dependencies
always_ask_dependencies.description: Package installs and removals run by a command.

always_ask_block_removal.label: Removing or moving Builder blocks
always_ask_block_removal.description: Even when other Builder operations run automatically.

unanswered.label: Unanswered requests
unanswered.description: What happens to a request nobody answers.

notify_requests.label: Notify me in the DMS
notify_requests.description: Shows a toast when a request arrives while the assistant panel is closed.

generation_mode.label: Scope
generation_mode.description: What the assistant may change in the project.
generation_mode.builder_missing: Needs the dms-builder module, which isn't loaded.

safe.label: Safe mode · recommended
safe.description: Changes pages, tables and queries through the Builder only. Every change typechecks before it's written; raw file edits and commands are blocked.

vibe.label: Code mode
vibe.description: Can also edit any project file and run commands, following the approval mode. For custom logic the Builder can't express.

allow_local_skills.title: Machine-local skills
allow_local_skills.label: Use machine-local skills
allow_local_skills.description: Adds skills from ~/.claude/skills on this machine. Not shared with teammates or other environments.

checkpoint_retention.label: Checkpoints
checkpoint_retention.description: Change sets older than this can no longer be undone.

empty.title: No skills loaded
empty.description: Modules that ship skills list them here. You can also add your machine's skills.

offline.title: Can't reach the assistant
offline.description: Skills come from the assistant, which isn't running. This isn't an empty list.

conflicts.title: {count} skill name is shared by several skills | {count} skill names are shared by several skills
conflicts.description: {names}: only one copy of the name is used, the other is marked Shadowed. Rename a copy to use both. | {names}: only one copy of each name is used, the others are marked Shadowed. Rename a copy to use them all.

offline.title: The assistant is offline
offline.description: Its sidecar isn't running. Restart it to use the assistant again.
offline.disabled: Its sidecar is turned off in this module's configuration.

waiting.description: Open the assistant to answer: the button in the header, or ⌘⇧K.
